name: Seed to Forest Accelerator
summary: Terraformation pays planting costs for large native reforestation projects in the tropics and subtropics and lines up forward carbon sales, with training, seed banking and monitoring support. Teams need long-term rights to thousands of hectares and apply online to join a cohort.

calls.label: Accelerator cohort application

status.quote: Apply now to join an upcoming cohort

calls.note: Applicants must have long-term access and rights to reforest at least 3,000 hectares in Colombia, Ghana, Kenya, or the Philippines, or at least 15,000 hectares in other countries.

geography.quote: Our Accelerator is open to forest restoration teams around the globe.
